sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Product Benefits Table)

room_rent.note: ICU/ICCU capped at 2% of SI/day. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if room rent limit exceeded.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay if insured is aged 61+ at Policy Inception Date. Zone-based co-pay also applicable. Optional cover 17 can waive mandatory co-pay.

sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹25,000 per eye per Policy Year. Specified psychiatric disorders (Severe Depression, Schizophrenia, Bipolar, PTSD, OCD, Panic, Personality disorders): ₹50,000 cumulative sub-limit with 36-month wait. IVF, Bariatric, Lasik, Psychiatric covered up to limits in Product Benefits Table.

deductible.note: Aggregate Deductible and Per Claim Deductible available as optional covers.

initial_waiting.note: Can be reduced to 7 days if opted in policy schedule. Optional cover 19 or 35 (Insta Cover) can reduce further.

ped_waiting.note: Optional cover 18 allows reduction. Insta Cover (optional cover 35) can reduce to Day 1 for declared/accepted conditions.

specific_disease_waiting.note: List of 17 conditions including cataract, hernia, knee/hip replacement etc. Optional cover 28 allows reduction.

maternity.note: Maternity is NOT inbuilt in Support plan. Available as Optional Cover 7 (48-month wait) or Optional Cover 30 (12-month wait, 3-yr policy only).

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of SI per year, max 50%. Bonus Booster optional cover upgrades to 20%/yr up to 100%. Sub-limits do not increase with bonus.

restoration.note: 100% recharge unlimited times from 2nd claim onwards in a policy year for unrelated illness/injury. Optional cover 13 extends recharge to same/related illness.

pre_hosp.note: Default per policy; exact days per Product Benefits Table. Optional cover 9 (Enhanced Pre & Post) upgrades to 60 days.

post_hosp.note: Default per policy; exact days per Product Benefits Table. Optional cover 9 upgrades to 90 days; optional cover 23 (Extensive Post) upgrades to 180 days if cover 9 also opted.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered per hospitalisation up to limit in Product Benefits Table. Air ambulance available as optional cover 16.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, HIFU, deep brain stimulation etc. covered.

consumables.note: Optional cover 12 covers non-payable/consumable items listed in Annexure II List I.

global_cover.note: Global Cover (optional cover 21) explicitly states 'except for support plan'. Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization (inbuilt in Premium; optional cover 10 for others) covers emergency abroad up to 50% of SI max ₹10L with ₹2L deductible.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode.

notable_exclusions: Sleep apnea, genetic/hereditary disorders (Crohn's, Haemophilia, Neurofibromatosis etc.), external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), OPD (unless optional), war/terrorism
optional_riders: Critical Illness lump sum, Personal Accident, Aggregate/Per Claim Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay, Maternity (48mo wait), OPD cover, Global cover, Air ambulance, Non-payable items, Recharge for same illness, Bonus Booster, Insta Cover (Day-1 PED)
